description: Offline retrieval fixtures for a fictional Northwind Services handbook. Dense rankings are fixed test fixtures so evaluation does not call an embedding API.

chunks.text: Employees may claim up to $45 per day for meals during approved business travel. Alcohol is not reimbursable, and itemized receipts are required for each meal.
Use a personal vehicle only when approved by a manager. Mileage is reimbursed at the current finance rate, excluding ordinary travel between home and the office.
FIN-AP-204: Purchase orders above $5,000 require approval from two managers before the supplier is contacted. Orders at or below $5,000 require one manager approval.
Accounts payable matches each supplier invoice to its purchase order and receipt. Disputed invoices are placed on hold until the requester confirms delivery.
Single sign-on (SSO) sessions require a fresh multi-factor authentication (MFA) challenge every 12 hours, and immediately after a sign-in from an unrecognized device.
Passwords must contain at least 14 characters. Shared accounts are prohibited, and access credentials must never be sent through email or chat.
Application and access logs are retained for 90 days in the standard tier. Security incident records are exported to the protected archive before the online retention window expires.
Production databases receive an encrypted backup every 24 hours. The on-call engineer verifies the backup job each morning and performs a restore test once per quarter.
SLA-2 tickets receive an initial human response within 2 business hours. The response target is not a resolution deadline; urgent service outages use the incident process.
The support team publishes a monthly service availability summary. Scheduled maintenance announced at least 48 hours in advance is excluded from the availability calculation.
Submit planned paid time off (PTO) at least 10 business days before the first day away. Your manager must approve the request in the HR portal before travel is booked.
Unused annual leave may carry over up to 5 days into the next calendar year. Local statutory leave rules take precedence where they provide a greater entitlement.
EDGE-410 field units require their air intake filters to be replaced every 1,800 operating hours. Record the replacement date and meter reading in the asset log.
EDGE-420 battery packs are inspected every six months. Remove a pack from service if its measured capacity is below 80 percent of its original rating.
DLP quarantine messages are kept for 30 days. A designated security reviewer may release a message after verifying the recipient and business purpose.
Confidential information may be shared only with approved recipients and must use the company-managed encrypted storage service.
When a customer is billed twice for one order, support verifies both charges and issues a credit within 5 business days. The confirmation is sent to the billing contact on file.
Tax amounts are calculated from the service address stored on the account at invoice time. Customers should update a changed address before the next billing cycle.
API-429 indicates that a client exceeded its request rate limit. Pause requests for the Retry-After interval when present, then resume with exponential backoff.
OAuth access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Applications should request a replacement token using the refresh flow and must not store client secrets in browser code.
During an evacuation, use the nearest marked exit and report to the assembly point in the east parking area. Do not re-enter until the safety lead gives authorization.
An approved RMA number must be shown on the return label. Ship the item within 30 calendar days of receiving the RMA or request a new authorization.
Photograph any visible transit damage before removing the packaging. Send the images and tracking number to the logistics desk within two business days.
A legal hold suspends routine deletion for the named records and custodians. The records manager notifies affected teams when a hold begins or is released.

cases.question: How much can an employee spend on meals each day when traveling for work?
cases.answer: Up to $45 per day, with itemized receipts.

cases.question: What does FIN-AP-204 say about purchase orders above $5,000?
cases.answer: They require approval from two managers before contacting the supplier.

cases.question: How often does an SSO user need to complete an MFA challenge?
cases.answer: Every 12 hours, and after a sign-in from an unrecognized device.

cases.question: For how long can we look up ordinary application and access logs?
cases.answer: The standard online retention period is 90 days.

cases.question: What is the initial response target for an SLA-2 ticket?
cases.answer: An initial human response within 2 business hours.

cases.question: How far ahead should I request planned paid leave?
cases.answer: At least 10 business days before the first day away.

cases.question: When should the filter in an EDGE-410 be changed?
What is the retention period for DLP quarantine messages?
What happens if a customer is charged twice for one order?
cases.answer: After verifying both charges, support issues a credit within 5 business days.

cases.question: How should a client respond to API-429, and what does Retry-After mean?
cases.answer: Wait for the Retry-After interval if present, then retry with exponential backoff.

cases.question: How do operations make sure a database can be recovered?
cases.answer: Back it up every 24 hours, verify the job daily, and perform a restore test quarterly.

cases.question: After an RMA is issued, how long do I have to send the item?
cases.answer: Ship it within 30 calendar days of receiving the RMA.
